messages:
Elias Gomez: Flagging weird spike in renewal_risk for accounts created between Feb 10-12. Looks like an import script set legacy_flag -> true and that feeds into healthscore. Opening thread to triage.
Nora Li: saw that too in the daily rollup. renewal_risk jumped from ~2% to 18% for that cohort. can we get sample export?
Elias Gomez: csv sample uploaded to /shared/cs/exports/renewal-spike-sample.csv. initial look: owner_id present but owner_last_active null for many. import overwrote last_contacted.
Samir Venkataraman: could be a mapping bug in the ETL where contact_date -> last_contacted was mapped wrongly. if so, playbooks could have been triggered en masse.
Tara Wilson: did we send nudges? any outbound activity?
CS Data Bot: playbook-audit: 2025-04-02 09:12 UTC detected 1,820 playbook events targeting imported_cohort_2025-02-10..12 between 2025-04-02 09:00 and 09:30.
Nora Li: that's not good. need immediate stop-gap: 1) suspend playbook triggers for tag imported_cohort_2025-02-10 2) run rollback to restore last_contacted from backup 3) notify owners.
Elias Gomez: agree. Proposed SQL to find affected accounts: ```SELECT a.account_id, a.owner_id, a.last_contacted, b.backup_last_contacted FROM accounts a JOIN accounts_backup b USING (account_id) WHERE a.source = 'bulk_import_202502' AND a.renewal_risk = true;```
Samir Venkataraman: rollback plan: restore last_contacted from accounts_backup for the affected set, then run a dry-run of playbook-filter with stricter gating (min_interactions > 3).
Tara Wilson: for owner notification let's avoid customer-facing emails until rollback completes. owner-pings only. create a Slack digest to owners with list and ask for confirmation before any outbound.
Nora Li: implementing immediate kill switch on playbook trigger for the import tag. will set feature_flag playbooks.imported_cohort_block=true.
CS Data Bot: feature-flag updated: playbooks.imported_cohort_block=true by @nora at 2025-04-02T09:25:10Z.
Elias Gomez: Samir can you prep a restore job and a small smoke test? start with 100 accounts in staging and verify playbook does NOT fire.
Samir Venkataraman: on it. restore command (dry run): ```curl -X POST https://internal.cs.ops/run-restore -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"source_tag":"bulk_import_202502","limit":100,"dry_run":true}'```
Tara Wilson: I'll draft owner note template: short, FYI, we've paused automated outreach for affected accounts while we validate data; no customer messages sent. will post in #owners channel.
Nora Li: after restore and verification, we should add a permanent ETL assertion to prevent nulling owner_last_active and add a datapipeline monitor alert.
Elias Gomez: also add a playbook gating rule: if last_contacted is null OR owner_last_active < now()-interval '90 days' then do NOT run renewal outreach. implement as a pre-filter.
Samir Venkataraman: testing timeline: restore dry-run in staging now, full restore to prod after owner ack and CI checks, ETA 3 hours.
CS Data Bot: restore-job queued: restore-job-7834 (dry_run=true, sample=100).
Tara Wilson: thanks all. once prod restore done, let's run a retrospective to update runbooks and add a rollback checklist.
Elias Gomez: agreed. owners notified. follow-ups: Samir will post restore logs, Nora will keep flag up until Wednesday PM, Tara will run owner comms, I'll schedule retro. Closing thread when done. :white_check_mark:
